guide:
Each item is one search: a photo of a furnished room (look at the piece named), the
piece, the search the system ran for it, and the top candidates it returned from the catalog.
Grade each candidate, by looking at its photo against the piece in the room photo:
2 = the same product, or one you cannot tell apart (same shape, material and color);
1 = an acceptable alternative: the same kind of piece, close in style and color, that someone
    who wanted that piece could buy instead;
0 = not useful: another kind of piece, or clearly different.
Judge what you see, not the names.

Use: anchoring a seating area, statement floor piece; living room, bedroom, study
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, bohemian
Materials: flatwoven wool-like yarn with a ribbed texture
Colors: light warm beige, aqua blue, taupe brown, blush pink, lemon yellow, navy
Shape: rectangular, flat, nested elongated diamonds and crossing lines drawn as thin colored strokes, airy linear pattern, light visual weight
Feel: airy, artful, cheerful, light
Goes with: light wood, white walls, pastel textiles, brass or black accents; Scandinavian, modern or eclectic rooms

Type: large flatwoven area rug
Use: covering a dining or seating area; dining room, living room, kitchen
Style: minimalist, contemporary, industrial
Materials: tight synthetic-look flat weave, fine basket-weave texture
Colors: dark charcoal grey, black flecks
Shape: large rectangle with small checked weave texture, thin flat profile, plain edges, solid grounding visual weight
Feel: practical, understated, grounded
Goes with: light wood, white or grey walls, black metal, concrete; industrial, modern or minimalist dining and living rooms

Type: flatwoven area rug
Use: softening and defining a floor area, under a sofa or dining table; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: flatwoven fibre with a fine basket-weave texture
Colors: dark charcoal grey, cool
Shape: rectangular, flat and thin, solid tone with a subtle woven dot texture, clean straight edges, large and quiet
Feel: grounded, calm, understated
Goes with: light wood, white or grey walls, black metal; minimalist, industrial or Scandinavian rooms
